title: Get Upgrades
script:
-- Change this value at the top to change all upgrades to that number.
--// Keep Upgrading Flowers == OP
--// You can remove any you don't need but some like spawn and cut range actually works. (I'm too lazy to find out)


local newValue = 10000

local player = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local upgradesFolder = player.Upgrades

local upgradesList = {

    "Stellarize_XPMultiplier",

for _, upgradeName in ipairs(upgradesList) do
    local upgrade = upgradesFolder:FindFirstChild(upgradeName)
    if upgrade and upgrade:IsA("NumberValue") then
        upgrade.Value = newValue
        print(upgradeName .. " updated to " .. tostring(newValue))
    else
        warn("Upgrade '" .. upgradeName .. "' not found or is not a NumberValue.")
    end
end
